## Add

```bash
zweb add dropdown-menu
```

## Imports

Styled registry component:

```tsx
import { DropdownMenu } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'
```

Primitive React wrapper:

```tsx
import { DropdownMenu } from '@zeus-web/dropdown-menu/react'
```

Web Component entry:

```ts
import '@zeus-web/dropdown-menu/wc/auto'
```

## Props

| Prop          | Type      | Default | Description                      |
| ------------- | --------- | ------- | -------------------------------- |
| `open`        | `boolean` | -       | Controlled open state.           |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | -       | Initial uncontrolled open state. |
| `disabled`    | `boolean` | -       | Disables the trigger and items.  |
| `value`       | `string`  | -       | Item selection value.            |

## Events

| Event         | React prop     | Detail                                                          | Description                               |
| ------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `open-change` | `onOpenChange` | `open: boolean, nativeEvent: Event`                             | Emitted when open state changes.          |
| `select`      | `onSelect`     | <code>value: string &#124; undefined, nativeEvent: Event</code> | Emitted when an enabled item is selected. |

## Slots

| Slot      | Description                      |
| --------- | -------------------------------- |
| `default` | Menu trigger, content and items. |

## Examples

### React styled usage

```tsx
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger>Actions</DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuItem value="rename">Rename</DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  )
}
```
